summary: A large conversational input for logging a mess, with voice toggle and send.
purpose: The primary intake on the app surface. Reach for it when the user should describe something in their own words; it composes the Input atom and adds submit and voice affordances.

anatomy.description: A multiline, underline-only text field in serif type.
Toggles a listening state for voice input.
Appears once there is text; submits the entry.
A pulsing dot and label shown while listening.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the trimmed text when the user submits.

props.name: isThinking
props.description: Loading state while the system responds; disables input.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field and its buttons.

whenToUse: The main conversational intake where the user logs a mess in their own words.
Any free-text entry that should feel like talking to a friend.

whenNotToUse.scenario: Choosing among a few fixed options

do: Keep one ChatInput as the focal intake on the surface.
dont: Use it for rigid structured data; that belongs in Input.
Submit on Enter+Shift; that inserts a newline by design.

keyboard: Voice and send buttons are focusable.
aria: Voice button has an aria-label that reflects listening state.
Send button has aria-label Send message.
accessibility.contrast: Entered text and placeholder meet contrast against the canvas; the placeholder stays legible.
accessibility.focus: Focus-within moves the underline to the primary color.

examples.title: Dashboard intake
examples.code: <ChatInput onSubmit={handleSubmit} placeholder="What's weighing on you right now?" />

related.whenToChoose: Input is the base atom for structured fields; ChatInput is the conversational intake built on it.
Use ClarifyingDialog for a fixed-choice follow-up after intake.
